item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Level 1 storm returns Sunday
item.description: There will be dry weather for Valentine's Day dinner but light rain arrives late at night, turning into heavier rain by Sunday.

item.title: Part of Underground Railroad found in closet of New York City museum
item.description: The Underground Railroad was a secret pathway to freedom for enslaved people escaping north, through woods, tunnels, private homes, under floorboards, inside churches and even hidden beneath wagons.

item.title: Judge declares mistrial in Stanford student pro-Palestinian protests case
item.description: A Santa Clara County judge declared a mistrial Friday in the case of five current and former Stanford University students charged with felonies after barricading themselves inside the president's and provost's offices amid pro-Palestinian protests in 2024.

item.title: Prominent school photography company Lifetouch under scrutiny amid Epstein files rumor: What to know
item.description: Lifetouch, one of the most prominent school photography companies in the country, is facing district investigations and canceled school photo days over Jeffrey Epstein files rumors. Here's what parents and students should know.

item.title: SF Ghirardelli workers hold Valentine's Day strike outside iconic chocolate and ice cream shop
item.description: Valentine's Day was a not-so-sweet treat for one of San Francisco's iconic chocolate makers. Employees picketed all day Saturday at Ghirardelli's longtime ice cream and chocolate shop at Ghirardelli Square.

item.title: Gubernatorial candidate Matt Mahan visits Skid Row, says he supports 'involuntary treatment'
item.description: Although San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan is well-known in Northern California, that's not the case in Southern California.

item.title: States reliant on Colorado River fail to meet latest deadline to find water use consensus
item.description: The seven Western states that depend on the Colorado River missed a deadline for the second time Saturday to agree on a plan addressing record drought and water shortages.

item.title: Oakland's Keshad Johnson, Damian Lillard dominate NBA All-Star Slam Dunk and 3-point contests
item.description: Oakland natives Keshad Johnson and Damian Lillard both earned top titles at this year's NBA All-Star weekend. Johnson of the Miami Heat won the Slam Dunk on Saturday. Lillard isn't playing this season. He still scored big anyway, winning the 3-point contest over Devin Booker.

item.title: European nations say Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with dart frog toxin
item.description: Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny was poisoned by the Kremlin with a rare and lethal toxin found in the skin of poison dart frogs, five European countries said.

item.title: SF losing $8 million in HIV grant funding, impacting treatment and prevention services
item.description: The San Francisco Department of Public Health says the Centers for Disease Control is pulling $8 million in grants which will largely impact HIV treatment and prevention services. The White House said the grants no longer reflect CDC priorities.
